name: ShopElement – Elementor Addons for WooCommerce Product Grid, Carousel & Category Widgets
author: StorePlugin

sections.description:
ShopElement is a powerful collection of Elementor Addons for WooCommerce, designed to help you build modern, conversion focused stores using the Elementor page builder. With ShopElement, you can create fully custom shop layouts, product showcases, promotional banners, and interactive sliders without writing a single line of code.

This plugin offers a rich set of WooCommerce focused widgets including Product Grid, Product List, Product Carousel, Store Features, Customer Reviews, Product Categories, Banners, and Brand Logos. Each widget is fully customizable inside Elementor, giving you total control over design, layout, spacing, colors, typography, hover effects, and responsiveness.

Whether you are building a new WooCommerce store or improving an existing one, ShopElement helps you create visually appealing, user-friendly shop pages that improve engagement and increase sales.

🌟 What You Can Build with ShopElement

  • Modern Product Grids for shop and landing pages
  • Clean Product Lists to highlight essential details
  • Interactive Product Carousels for featured or trending items
  • Attractive Product Banners for sales and promotions
  • Custom Store Feature Sections (Free Shipping, Support, Returns)
  • Beautiful Brand Logo displays
  • Engaging Customer Review Carousels
  • Stylish Product Category Blocks for easier navigation

🔎 Detailed Feature Breakdown

1. Product Grid Widget

Display WooCommerce products in a modern, responsive grid. Control the number of products, columns, ordering, hover animation, price visibility, ratings, buttons, and badges. Ideal for shop pages, homepages, and promotional sections.

2. Product List Widget

A clean vertical layout for displaying products in a minimal list style. Great for sidebars, recommendation blocks, mobile-friendly shops, and content-driven layouts.

3. Store Feature Widget

Highlight key selling points of your shop—such as Free Shipping, Secure Checkout, Easy Returns, or 24/7 Support. Helps build trust and increases conversion rates.

4. Product Carousel Widget

Showcase products in an interactive slider. Includes autoplay, navigation arrows, infinite loop, speed control, and responsive settings. Perfect for best sellers, featured items, or seasonal campaigns.

5. Product Banner Widget

Create beautiful promotional banners with product images, overlay text, call-to-action buttons, and hover animations. Useful for sale campaigns, hero sections, or product announcements.

6. Brand Logo Widget

Display brand, vendor, or partner logos in a grid or slider layout. Enhances credibility and creates a professional brand presence.

7. Customer Review Carousel Widget

Present testimonials or customer reviews in a rotating slider format. Helps create trust and social proof to improve conversions.

8. Product Category Widget

Display WooCommerce product categories with images, titles, product counts, and custom styling. Helps users browse your store easily and boosts navigation flow.

Why Use ShopElement?

  • Designed for WooCommerce + Elementor
  • Fully customizable widgets with deep styling control
  • Lightweight and optimized for fast performance
  • Works with Elementor Free (Pro not required)
  • Compatible with all modern WordPress and WooCommerce themes
  • Perfect for creating custom shop pages, landing pages, and promotional sections
  • Beginner-friendly but powerful enough for advanced users

PRO Features

Unlock premium layouts, widgets, and advanced options with ShopElement Pro:

  • ⭐ Product Grid – 2 premium layouts
  • ⭐ Product List – 2 premium layouts
  • ⭐ Product Carousel – 2 premium layouts
  • ⭐ Product Banner – 4 premium layouts
  • ⭐ Customer Review Carousel – 2 premium layouts
  • ⭐ Product Category – 2 premium layouts
  • ⭐ Image Marker with Product (Hotspot) – 2 premium layouts
  • ⭐ Product Image Accordion – 2 advanced interactive layouts

👉 Get ShopElement Pro

ShopElement gives you the freedom to design a WooCommerce store exactly the way you want – visually, easily, and professionally.
sections.faq:
1. Does ShopElement work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, ShopElement works with all Elementor-compatible themes and any WooCommerce theme.

2. Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

No. The free version of Elementor is enough to use all free ShopElement widgets.

3. Is the plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes. ShopElement loads only the widgets you use and follows Elementor coding standards.

4. Can I customize product grids and carousels?

Absolutely. You can control layout, spacing, typography, hover effects, buttons, colors, and more.

5. Is ShopElement compatible with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is actively maintained and compatible with the latest versions of WordPress, Elementor, and WooCommerce.

6. What extra features come with Pro?

The Pro version includes premium layouts, advanced widgets like Image Marker, Product Image Accordion, and more styling features.

7. Can I use these widgets on any page?

Yes. You can use ShopElement widgets on homepages, landing pages, shop pages, or any custom Elementor page.

8. How do I get support?

Free users can use the WordPress.org forum. Pro customers get priority support via our website.

9. Will this plugin affect my website speed?

No. ShopElement is optimized for performance and loads assets only when needed.

10. Where can I upgrade to Pro?

You can upgrade anytime at:
https://storeplugin.net/plugins/shopelement/?utm_source=wporg&utm_campaign=seorder&utm_medium=link
